outcome: Obstructive voiding symptoms at 3 months postpartum
cohort: 489 pregnant women who had cesarean delivery at ≥ 36 gestational weeks at a tertiary hospital
finding: Emergency cesarean delivery, prolonged operation time, and postoperative analgesia were independent risk factors of PVD after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was shown to be an independent risk factor for postpartum voiding difficulty.
